scope: Actual installed browser Open/Save and current AppImage chooser on private X11/bus/profile; private portal definition projection; production installation setup was tested separately

flatpak_scope.startup_guard: Actual sandbox shell requires the outside original file to be invisible before invoking installed falkon; prints real /.flatpak-info
flatpak_scope.private_runtime_alias: Sandbox-local symlink from the temporary runtime/doc URL prefix to Flatpak standard /run/flatpak/doc per-app mount; no fixture filesystem access added

open_save: Actual native Open and Save dialogs both owned by the delivered AppImage chooser; Open displays the outside-sandbox selected document; Save writes exact synthetic bytes from the opened local text document
popup_arrow_escape_scope: Actual Flatpak file-type popup ArrowDown/Escape retains chooser; following Open/Save verifies original folder/file
identity_scope: Parent runner verifies actual installed browser attribution independently from the frontend log; this controller verifies Open/Save bytes and chooser ownership.
identity_evidence: Actual FileChooser backend OpenFile and SaveFile calls both carry the installed browser app ID
identity_limit: Exact installed browser identity on private session; physical desktop and other browser packages remain separate.
